column1: Coastal American Airways - Airport-to-Airport O&D Matrix (Consolidated)

Average daily O&D passengers, real BTS DB1C data, simple mean of 6 months: July 2025, April 2026, December 2025, February 2026, January 2026, November 2025. Secondary-airport rows use the dampened own/primary blend (see BLEND_WEIGHTS in process_chunk.py). Rows = origin, Columns = destination. Values are directional.
